howTo.title: How to use
items: Enter one name per line. You can paste a list from a chat; commas and line breaks both work.
Add two people who shouldn't draw each other (couples, family) under Don't pair.
Budget, exchange date and note are shown in everyone's link.
Copy each person's link and send it privately. They see the name only after opening the link and tapping Reveal.

missions.title: Mission ideas
items: Leave a coffee on their desk in the morning
Slip a one-line compliment into their drawer or bag
Find out their favourite snack and leave it for them
Be the first to react to their messages in the group chat
Quietly help tidy their desk
Say hello to them first once a day
Ask about what's on their mind and leave a cheering note
Back their favourite lunch pick
Write a handwritten card for the reveal day
Write an acrostic poem with their name
Recommend a song that suits them
Stay undiscovered until the reveal day

tips.title: Tips
items: Set a budget like 'about 30,000 KRW' so gifts feel balanced.
Pick a reveal day in advance and finish with a 'guess who was your Santa' round.
Posting all links in one group chat lets people peek. Send them one by one.
Changing names or drawing again changes the assignment. Finalize the list before sending links.
Because it's one loop, if A has B, B never has A, so no awkward mutual pairs.

items.a: Each person secretly looks after one other person for a while, and on the last day everyone reveals who had whom. It's popular for year-end parties, Christmas, classes and clubs.

items.q: Can the organizer see the result?
items.a: The organizer sees only copy buttons per person; the full result appears only when you expand 'Show the full result'. If you're also playing, don't expand it and open only your own link.

items.q: Are names in the link? Is anything stored on a server?
items.a: The assignment is obscured after the # in the link, and that part is never sent to the server. ToolHub stores no lists or results; only the organizer's last list stays in their browser. It's obscured, not encrypted, so anyone with the link can open it. Send each link only to its owner.
Pick two people who shouldn't be each other's Santa and tap Add. They won't be linked in either direction. With 3 people everyone is linked, so any rule makes the draw impossible.
From 3 to 50. More people leave room for more don't-pair rules.

items.q: What happens to links I already sent if I draw again?
items.a: Drawing again makes a new assignment, while links already sent keep showing the old one. Send everyone new links after drawing again.
